[[File:MosEisleyImperialGarrison2.jpg|200px|thumb|The Imperial outpost overlooking Mos Eisley]]
An '''Imperial outpost''' overlooking the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] was in operation by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Situated on top of a mesa overlooking the city, it consisted of several buildings and a couple pens for [[Dewback/Legends|dewbacks]]. The [[Garrison/Legends|garrison]] was staffed by a number of [[Imperial officer/Legends|Imperial officers]] and [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]].<ref name="SWG:P25" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|It's simple really. I figure if you are undercover for Corsec, or the Imps you won't want to get into it with some Stormtroopers. Now I don't want you to take a Stormie's helmet or anything that crazy. But there is a corral of Dewbacks near an outpost of newly arrived Imps. They are using them as mounts, until their vehicles are properly acclimatized. Just wipe out a few of those Dewbacks.|[[K'cur]], to a spacer|<ref name="stf">{{GalaxiesNGE}} tatooine_knives_parry_kcur.stf</ref>}}
The Imperial outpost overlooking Mos Eisley was a location in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:P25" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Imperial outpost was added to the game with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]," a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref>

The Imperial outpost was intended to be part of the cancelled [https://swglegends.com/forums/showthread.php?55817-*Friday-Feature-Valarian-Themepark-Walkthrough!*Valarian Themepark]. This questline was initially planned to be introduced in the game with the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 23 Notes for 31 August 2005|Publish 23]]" to replace the original "[[W:c:swg:Valarian Theme Park (pre-NGE)|Valarian Quest Series]]."<ref name="SonyCite-Valarian Quest Update">{{SonyCite|url=content.jsp?page=Current%20Publish|text=Valarian Quest Update}}</ref> Although the old "Valarian Quest Series" was deactivated with the release of Publish 23 on [[August 31]], [[2005]],<ref>{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=swgpatchnotes&message.id=770|text=Update Notes: Publish 23}}</ref> the new Themepark was never activated.<ref name="SonyCite-In Development">{{SonyCite|url=content.jsp?page=In%20Development|text=In Development}}</ref> The Imperial outpost was implemented into the game but it was not involved in any quest.<ref name="SWG:P25" /> Unused game files pertaining to this questline indicated that the outpost should have been named the '''Stormtrooper Outpost''' and was intended to be part of a new quest named "Parry". In this quest, [[Lady/Legends|Lady]] [[Valarian/Legends|Valarian's]] henchman [[K'cur]] tasked a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] with killing the dewbacks at the Imperial outpost.<ref>{{GalaxiesNGE}} tatooine_knives_parry.stf</ref>
